reason: A DSH plugin for agent-managed long-term memory, providing structured cross-session storage, retrieval, browsing, updating, archival, statistics, and episodic compression across global and workspace scopes.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供由智能体管理的跨会话长期记忆，支持结构化存储、检索、浏览、更新、归档和情景记忆压缩。
summaries.en: Provides agent-managed long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness with structured cross-session storage, retrieval, browsing, updates, archival, and episodic memory compression.

capabilities: memory retrieval with keyword, level, tag, and time filters
memory update, merge, and archival operations
inbox notifications triggered by session compression
